property_summary: For any caller, sudicideAnyone either reverts (non-owner) or destroys C and transfers its entire balance to the calling owner (msg.sender); the mutant redirects those funds to the stored owner instead of the caller, breaking the invariant that the caller receives the destroyed contract's funds.

For ANY caller, sudicideAnyone either reverts or (caller == stored owner and) the caller msg.sender is credited the contract's entire prior balance while c's balance drops to zero and the owner is unchanged; the mutant reroutes the destroyed funds to the stored owner instead of msg.sender, so a caller that is not the stored owner either succeeds without being credited (if the guard is weakened) or the credited party is not the caller, breaking the rule for some input.

For any admissible caller, sudicideAnyone either reverts or, when the caller is the stored owner, the caller msg.sender is credited the contract's entire prior balance while address(c).balance drops to zero; the mutant instead credits the stored owner rather than the caller, so a caller that is not the stored owner (or any mismatch between caller and credited party) violates this rule for some input.

For any caller and any balance, sudicideAnyone must either revert or credit the CALLER (msg.sender) with c's entire prior balance while c's balance drops to zero; the mutant pays the stored owner instead, so any caller other than the stored owner that is not reverted (or is not the credited party) violates this rule.
sudicideAnyone must revert when called by an address that is not the smartfix_owner.
sudicideAnyone reverts exactly when the caller is not the recorded smartfix_owner (and succeeds for the owner).
